description: This file defines functions and constants related to z-index management and element movement within a drawing application, including moving elements left/right, handling frame and group boundaries, and reordering elements.

methods.name: isOfTargetFrame
methods.description: Checks if an element belongs to a specific frame or has a matching id.

methods.name: getIndicesToMove
methods.description: Calculates indices of elements to move, including contiguous deleted elements between selected elements.

methods.name: toContiguousGroups
methods.description: Splits an array of indices into contiguous groups.

methods.name: getTargetIndexAccountingForBinding
methods.description: Finds the target index for moving an element, considering bindings to containers or text elements.

methods.name: getContiguousFrameRangeElements
methods.description: Returns a contiguous range of elements within a specific frame.

methods.name: moveArrowAboveBindable
methods.description: Moves an arrow element above bindable elements it intersects or hovers over.

methods.name: getTargetIndex
methods.description: Determines the next index to move an element to, considering group and frame boundaries.

methods.name: getTargetElementsMap
methods.description: Creates a map of element IDs to elements for specified indices.

methods.name: shiftElementsByOne
methods.description: Shifts selected elements one position left or right.

methods.name: shiftElementsToEnd
methods.description: Moves selected elements to the start or end of the list, considering frames and groups.

methods.name: shiftElementsAccountingForFrames
methods.description: Handles shifting elements with respect to frames and groups, applying a shift function.

methods.name: moveOneLeft
methods.description: Public API to move selected elements one position to the left.

methods.name: moveOneRight
methods.description: Public API to move selected elements one position to the right.

methods.name: moveAllLeft
methods.description: Public API to move all selected elements to the left.

methods.name: moveAllRight
methods.description: Public API to move all selected elements to the right.
